_about: Make Your Mind Up's research library in Drive (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-11: every piece's research is kept in one Drive research library, mirrored from the engine's store, and filed by every session). A readable copy of the piece store's research, never a second record. Kept apart from studio.json, whose contents are bound into the media standard's hash. The engine finds both by ID (apps/control-plane/api/_researchLibrary.ts holds the same two, and tests/control-plane/research-library.test.ts holds them equal); verified in live Drive on 2026-11-11, made that day by Krish's request. docs/DRIVE.md, "The research library", says what goes in it.
